1459. Generating Valid Parentheses

Problem Statement:
Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all possible combinations of well-formed parentheses using recursion.
input_spec: - A single integer n, representing the number of pairs of parentheses.
output_spec: - A list of strings, where each string represents a valid combination of well-formed parentheses.
